decisions.reason: The track spotlight has kept its own page for two years, which suggests it meets the firm's aspiration level in a core lighting segment, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
The ceiling luminaire has had a dedicated page for two consecutive years, which signals stable performance in the established business, so management has no reason to reallocate its resources.
The flexible spotlight is new and has its own page, and its results are still uncertain, so organisational slack lets the firm carry it rather than judge it early.
The multi-outlet canopy fits the firm's luminaire system offering and was recently launched, so it is kept while its performance against aspiration becomes clear.
The low-voltage canopy partly overlaps with product D, which adds some risk of consolidation, but as a fresh launch it will likely be given time.
The glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than given their own page, which suggests weaker emphasis and higher risk, but one year is too little evidence of a shortfall to drop them.
